lean.note: Definition contains all-one column, promised instances, actual transcripts at true address and outward pointers. Actual circuit evaluation is the unique consistent transcript (construction_transcript_correct). No realization premise is needed for this semantic definition.
The equivalence is for arbitrary circuit and partial function; WinsAt is defined by actual promised values and gate consistency in Statement.lean. Realization is not assumed.

adjudication_findings.claim: F is total; pointer encodings have no invalid patterns; define WinsAt as a total predicate.
adjudication_findings.reason: m=2^l gives a bijection of l-bit words onto [m]. Adopted with the fidelity row claim-winner-fidelity.

adjudication_findings.claim: Make WinsAt primitive; eq-8 at a general address; def-winner depends on it.
adjudication_findings.reason: Accepted with a new fidelity row, since the paper's wording defines it the other way round.

adjudication_findings.claim: With WinsAt primitive, the bridge to the paper's 'winner' needs the circuit's correctness.
adjudication_findings.reason: IsWinner := exists s, WinsAt is not the paper's definition until the d,b tests are tied to P. Otherwise a wrong circuit makes the theorem about a different function.

statement: Column i is a winner iff X_i=1^m, every P(A_{i,h}) is defined, and the cell B_{i,s_i} contains correct evaluation transcripts on all A_{i,h} and pointers satisfying eq-8.
